properties.name: APIM_LOGS_KEY
properties.description:
APIM_LOGS_KEY is what we were previously referring to as the EVENT_ID. It is generated at the point of ingestion. APIM_LOGS_KEY first appears on the IDAP_LAKE.APPLICATION_EVENTS.APIM_LOGS table and is carried through to subsequent database objects. 

IDAP_LAKE.APPLICATION_EVENTS.APIM_LOGS **should not be truncated.** If a case arises in which the decision is made to truncate IDAP_LAKE.APPLICATION_EVENTS.APIM_LOGS, the subsequent tables will also need to be truncated i.e. DIM_APP_EVENT, DIM_APP_DEVICE, DIM_APP_EVENT_PARAMETER, BRIDGE_EVENT_PARAMETER, FACT_APP_MOBILE_EVENT.
